summary: The fourth UX browser review run of Phase 3 (P3.8) of track storytime_look_20261107 ran at role_base_sha 583c9ce805d6d60f34d8f5788aaee69e6a09c74e, which is the current HEAD. One launch ran. The run reused the production build of 22:55:40 from the same HEAD (SKIP_BUILD=1, the diff of apps/storytime since 583c9ce80 is empty). All 22 rows pass. The seven week pages w01 to w07 each hold a capture with console_errors=0 and failed_requests=0. Each week w02 to w07 gives tap_wNN=own_clip: the clip of the tapped word is requested (clip_requested=1) and the word is selected (selected=1). The removed word 'balls' gives tap_w02_no_clip=no_clip_target. taps_checked=7, the floor of 7 holds. review_draft_weeks=1 and review_draft_media=1. The cause of the run 3 tap failures is the harness: the clicks of run 3 landed before React hydration, so no handler ran. The fix waits for network idle and for the React fiber on the mode button before the mode click. No phone result is claimed. A wrapper defect of heavy-run.sh printed a syntax error after run.sh exited 0; it did not touch the measured run.
nonblocking_findings: N1 [Note] ux-browser-review: the wrapper heavy-run.sh printed 'line 1077: syntax error near unexpected token `fi'' after run.sh printed its final line '=== Total: 22 rows, all PASS ===' and exited 0, so the launch command exited 2. The run folder, the servers, the database container and the measurements were complete and clean at that point. The defect sits in /home/daniebo/Desktop/advantage-pr/scripts/jobs/heavy-run.sh, which is outside the write scope of this review. The PM owns that script.

N2 [Note] ux-browser-review: the app ties the pressed state of the mode buttons to a playing clip (apps/storytime/app/[locale]/st/[level]/[week]/reader.tsx line 196), so the aria-pressed of the My turn button reads false right after the mode click and true while the clip plays. The probes show wNN_my_turn_pressed=0 after the mode click and wNN_my_turn_pressed_after_clip=1 while the clip plays. This is the app behaviour and not a defect, and the pass rule does not use the pressed state.

N3 [Note] ux-browser-review: the word clip plays on a detached Audio element of the app (reader.tsx line 218 creates it), so the src of the DOM audio element stays empty (audio_srcs=[""]) even when the clip plays. The clip request is proven by the network response of the signed mp3 URL, not by a DOM audio src.

Hydration probe: logs/playwright.log lines 24, 39, 51, 63, 75 and 87 read wNN_hydrated=1 for w02 to w07. The harness waited for network idle and for the React fiber on the mode button before the mode click.

Mode button probe: logs/playwright.log lines 25, 40, 52, 64, 76 and 88 read wNN_mode_buttons=["อ่านให้ฟัง","ตาฉัน","ช้า ๆ"], so the selector button[data-mode-button] nth(1) is the My turn button on every week.

Console probe: the own-clip rows read console=[] and the word coverage rows read console_errors=0 failed_requests=0 (lines 38, 50, 62, 74, 86, 98), so no page console message and no failed request exists on any tap page. audio_failed=0 on every own-clip row, so mediaUrl() never returned an empty string.

The my_turn_pressed semantics: logs/playwright.log lines 28, 43, 55, 67, 79 and 91 read wNN_my_turn_pressed=0 right after the mode click, and lines 29, 44, 56, 68, 80 and 92 read wNN_my_turn_pressed_after_clip=1 while the clip plays. This matches reader.tsx line 196 and is not a fault.

The cause of the run 3 tap failures: the harness. Run 3 (logs/playwright.log of 22:59, overwritten by this run) failed all six own-clip taps with clip_requested=0 selected=0 while the no-clip tap passed trivially, because a no-op click also fires no clip and selects no word. The only change to the tap path of browser.mjs between run 3 and run 4 is the added wait for network idle plus the wait for the React fiber (hydration) before the mode click, and this run passes every tap with hydrated=1. The app is not at fault: onWordTap (reader.tsx lines 362-396) returns silently only when the mode is not myTurn, when the word holds no clip, or when mediaUrl() returns an empty string, and the probes exclude all three (mode buttons work, clip_requested=1, audio_failed=0, no console error).

The keep-or-remove decision on the 23:06 edit of browser.mjs: the file kept the five harness fixes recorded in ux-browser-p3-583c9ce80.json and parsed clean (node --check, exit 0), so the edit stayed. The probes of this run were added on top of it.

History of the runs: run 1 ran at base 993dc3e7c and failed the build with four TS2345 errors in apps/storytime/__tests__/look-adversarial-p3-switch.test.ts; commit ff4a4b86d fixed them; result ux-browser-p3-993dc3e7c.json. Run 2 ran at base 583c9ce80 and every protected page answered the sign-in page, because the harness passed the session cookie before the sign-in filled it; result ux-browser-p3-583c9ce80.json. Run 3 ran at base 583c9ce80: the sign-in and the seven captures passed, the no-clip tap passed, and all six own-clip taps failed with clip_requested=0 selected=0 (taps_checked=1); the role then edited browser.mjs at 23:06 and ended with HTTP 400, and no result file exists for run 3. Run 4 is this run and passes.
